BiblicalUsage: A stump is what is left when the tree is cut down, and Daniel's dream leaves one standing on purpose. In Daniel 4:15 the watcher commands, leave the stump of his roots in the earth, in Daniel 4:23 the stump means the kingdom shall be sure unto thee, and in Daniel 4:26 the stump is the promise that the kingdom will be restored after the king learns that heaven rules.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stump is the mercy in the judgment: the tree falls, but the roots stay, and the kingdom grows back when the king bows.
